summary: This XML snippet defines a user interface element called an edit box—a text input field that users can type into. It gives the element an ID for reference, a label that describes it to users, and wires up a callback function that runs whenever the text inside changes.

explanations.4: onChange specifies the name of a function (OnEditBoxTextChanged) that will be called automatically each time the user types or modifies the text in this edit box.
